verdict.rationale: Evidence only indirectly shows quantization support via a community benchmark citing q4_K_M and int4 model variants run through Ollama, but there is no first-party documentation in the pack describing the range of supported quantization levels (e.g., 2-bit through 8-bit) or how to select them. missing for 10: official docs on quantization format range/selection, evidence of very-low-bit (2-3 bit) support, and independent confirmation of memory savings across the full precision spectrum.
